responsibility: This file implements text_art::canvas, the random-access 2D backing store used by the module’s renderers after layout is complete. It owns painting of individual styled_unichar cells and styled_string runs into an array2 grid, handling double-width characters and emoji-variation markers, and it serializes the final picture to pretty_printer output with style-manager driven SGR/URL transitions, per-line prefixing, and trailing-space trimming; it also provides debug helpers and canvas-level selftests.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable behavior of text_art::canvas—painting cells/text and serializing the grid to pretty_printer, plus debug helpers and tests—whereas gcc/text-art/canvas.h only defines the type and its API.
